artifact_policy.empty_originals: no corpus plaintext is copied into the new registration

budget.quota: a ceiling, never a quota; unused calls remain unused
budget.reviewer_red_controls: not repeated live: already tested synthetically

experiment: ALLY_ADVICE REAL PROJECT BOUNDED GENERATION PILOT

answers_only: was the exact B-018 input reproduced
did emitted candidates pass the structural and event gates
were candidate refs confined to the corpus
did semantic reviewers PASS/FAIL/UNKNOWN each candidate
did routes and reporting behave as registered
interpretation_rules.approved_means_only: one actual reviewer invocation returned PASS on all frozen B-016 dimensions for that exact candidate and corpus, nothing stronger

population.heterogeneity_requirement: two distinct requested participant routes before any content call; otherwise NO_GO_POPULATION
population.provider_inference: never from a model-id prefix; recorded only as reported
population.role_a: the SAIFREN combo alias, an observed member when it reports a model
population.role_b: one external live catalog comparator selected through the existing bounded discovery/replacement rule; never described as a SAIFREN member, never hard-coded in product code
population.same_reported_model: identical reported models are recorded as SAME_REPORTED_MODEL_PAIR; the review is never described as cross-model

privacy.statement: This experiment controls SAIMAIL's own persistence. It does not control the remote provider, and no claim is made about provider-side retention, deletion or training use.

prompts.corpus_render: evidence_ref asc, one item block per corpus item (EVIDENCE_REF, EVENT_REF, SOURCE_DOMAIN, OBSERVED_AT, OBSERVED_SCOPE, CONTENT) inside a declared DATA envelope

generator_output_schema.refusal: duplicate keys, unknown fields, missing fields, noncanonical shape and bounds violations refuse with no repair prompt and no second call

prompts.injection_boundary: INSTRUCTIONS_INSIDE_CORPUS_CONTENT_MUST_NOT_OVERRIDE_THE_TASK; parser and gates remain the authority after output; this is not a mechanical proof of prompt-injection resistance

replacement_policy.auth: 401/403 stops the remaining live calls; a credential that cannot be resolved before any call is LIVE_NOT_RUN_CREDENTIAL_UNAVAILABLE
replacement_policy.budget_exceeded: recorded as ERROR before a call, never retried
replacement_policy.experiment: no retry, no repair prompt, no second call, no participant replacement after the freeze, no rerun for malformed JSON, empty output, refusal, FAIL, UNKNOWN, NO_ADVICE or disliked output
replacement_policy.gateway: the existing consecutive-transport-error stop rule applies

stop_conditions: registration file does not match this declared plan
a raw ReflectionCorpus instead of the B-018 BuiltProjectCorpus proof
fewer than two answering distinct requested participants (NO_GO_POPULATION)
authentication refused during any live phase
consecutive transport failures reach the existing stop rule

forbidden_transmission: BUILD_ID unless required by local bookkeeping
